name: euclid-heath
description: Euclid's Elements in Thomas Heath's translation (Cambridge, 1908), all thirteen books, Euclid's text alone, cleaned to ASCII plain text for character-level language modelling.

source.name: Perseus Digital Library, The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements (Heath), TEI XML
source.license: Euclid (c. 300 BC) and Heath's translation (first published 1908; Heath died 1940) are in the public domain. Perseus's TEI text is released under CC BY-SA 4.0; the cleaned text is adapted from it and released under the same licence (LICENSE-TEXT.md).

format: plain text, ASCII, a paragraph per line
